units.source_text: 有时，天气变化无常，射出了微弱的阳光，

en.t: At times, the weather shifted unpredictably, and a faint sunlight broke through,

units.source_text: 诱使我想到路旁的大山毛榉树下那从树叶间隙流泻下来的激光下歇歇脚，

en.t: tempting me to rest for a while beneath the large beech tree by the roadside, in the sharp light streaming down through gaps in the leaves,

units.source_text: 可不知为什么，我却总觉得没有闲暇歇息，消磨时光。

en.t: but for some reason I always felt that I had no leisure to stop and rest or idle away the time.
